summary: This PR replaces the Greeting screen with a Quiz screen: a title and a scrolling list of 10 cards, each with a three-state checkbox. It also changes .gitignore so the whole .idea/ folder is ignored. I found nothing to flag. Each checkbox keeps its own state with rememberSaveable, so the choice survives screen rotation and scrolling. ToggleableState is an enum, so it can be saved without extra code. No .idea files are still tracked, so the new ignore rule is enough. The unused imports (MutableState, remember) are a lint matter, not a bug.
